SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'CKPC') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , GR_DATE , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , KEY_1 AS ADD_DATE , ADD_USER_ID , KEY_2 AS PLANT , KEY_3 AS ITEM_TYPE , PO_NO AS PO_NO , PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ , UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE , KEY_4 AS BUDGET_DEPT , KEY_5 AS ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ, A.STATUS
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
